subject: Incorrect promo credits applied to personal workspace — request to move to company org
messages:

To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Free credits applied to wrong workspace

Hi Soojin,

We signed up for the Redwood PLG trial this morning and received the $500 promo credits — thank you! Unfortunately the credits landed in my personal workspace (username: anna-whitechapel, workspace id: 112233) rather than our company organization (Whitechapel AI, workspace id: 987654).

Can you help move the promo credits to the company workspace? We need them attached to the org so our team can use them for an upcoming proof-of-concept. Happy to provide any IDs or paperwork.

Thanks,
Anna White
Head of ML, Whitechapel AI
anna.white@whitechapel.ai

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the mix-up. I can initiate a self-serve transfer for one-time promo credit reallocation, but I need a couple quick confirmations so we have an audit trail: 

- Confirm target workspace id: 987654 (Whitechapel AI)
- Confirm the source workspace id where the credits currently sit: 112233
- Confirm the promo amount you received ($500)

Jordan, Monica — tagging billing/CS to help with the transfer and to confirm any internal approvals we need. Monica, would you mind validating this won't affect any active promos or entitlements for Whitechapel? Jordan, can you advise on the transfer procedure and record keeping?

Anna — if you reply with the IDs I will start the request and include your procurement contact in the transfer note.

Best,

Quick internal note — we can do a one-time credit reallocation between workspaces for PLG promos, but it requires a recorded approval and an exported audit log for the transfer. Attaching a stubbed audit export below for the incoming signup so legal can sign off.

Attachment: audit-log-export-20260509.csv (contains signup event, promo code, original workspace id)

Action items for us:
- Rishi: please confirm legal OK for moving credits between orgs on a one-off basis (no cash value change).
- Soojin: get Anna to confirm IDs and procurement contact for acceptance.
- Jordan: once approved, I will create the billing adjustment and generate a transaction id to include in the customer's invoice history.

-Jordan

On reviewing the promo terms and the audit export: one-off internal reallocations are permitted for promo corrections, provided we capture: source workspace id, destination workspace id, amount, rationale, and approver. No precedent that would block this. Please follow the standard adjustment workflow and ensure the customer's procurement contact acknowledges receipt.

Approving: Rishi Malhotra (Legal)

-Rishi
